constraint: Passenger cap (1985 Settlement Agreement, 2014 amendment): 11.8 million annual passengers for 2021-2025; 12.2 million for 2026-2030, or 12.5 million if 11.21 million was served in 2021-2025 and mitigation conditions are met. The cap counts arriving and departing passengers; passenger figures in this tool's other data are departing passengers only.
Flight limit (2014 amendment): at most 95 Class A average daily departures through 2030.
Night curfew under the County's General Aviation Noise Ordinance; the County committed to maintain and enforce it through 2035.

Parallel runways are only 750 ft apart, below the 4,300 ft needed for independent side-by-side approaches, so arrivals go single-file when side-by-side landings aren't allowed (e.g. low visibility). A staggered procedure approved in Aug 2026 was reported to raise hourly arrivals from 36 to 42 in good weather. (Trade-press report.)

2016 community agreement (LAWA with ARSAC): the city agreed not to move the north runway; passenger gates capped at 153 through 2024, followed by rules until 2030 under which existing terminals cannot be expanded. Reported in 2016; current status not verified.
